THREE MATH FINDINGS, reported not fixed. (a) FORMULA CONTRADICTS ITS OWN PARENT: eq:syt-cell-tower is written with the Faddeev Phi_q and PLUS signs, but prop:mass-endomorphism-tower — which this block says it 'matches' — uses the symmetric q-dilogarithm Li_2^q with MINUS signs and negated arguments, and states outright that 'The Faddeev Phi_q form was empirically incompatible with isospin symmetry at q_0'. The two cannot both be the mass tower. (b) THE z^2 JUSTIFICATION IS FALSE FOR JM ELEMENTS: 'two successive Markov peels of commuting elements each contribute a factor z, so tr_M(L_{k1} L_{k2}) = z^2' requires tr_M(L_k) = z, but L_k is not a generator. L_2 = sigma_1^2 = (q - q^{-1}) sigma_1 + 1, so tr_M(L_2) = h z + 1 = 1.1281 at the proton pin under convention D, not z = 0.6127. Commutativity gives factorisation of the trace only against a peel axiom stated for generators. (c) CALIBRATION CAVEAT on the validation table: 'with E_0 calibrated per path on the proton' means each of the two columns carries its own free scale, so the D row (0.120% vs 0.105%) is within the calibration freedom and only the T / 3He rows (18.0% -> 0.277%, 60.1% -> 0.219%) carry signal. Also: this block indexes generators sigma_1..sigma_{n-1} while the rest of the chapter uses sigma_0..sigma_{n-2}.
